headline.en: CBRE Investment Management Acquires $1.6B Net-Lease Portfolio
headline.zh: CBRE Investment Management 收购 16 亿美元净租赁资产组合

summary.en: CBRE Investment Management, the $155 billion global investment arm of CBRE, acquired Tenet Equity's $1.6 billion net-lease platform, comprising 208 assets in 39 states and 12 million square feet. The portfolio is fully leased to middle-market industrial tenants with an average lease term of roughly 17 years, and CBRE IM will partner with Tenet Equity on managing the assets and growing the platform.
summary.zh: CBRE 旗下规模 1.55 万亿美元的全球投资部门 CBRE Investment Management 收购了 Tenet Equity 价值 16 亿美元的净租赁平台，包含分布于 39 个州的 208 项资产、共 1,200 万平方英尺。该资产组合全部出租给中型工业企业租户，平均租期约 17 年；CBRE IM 将与 Tenet Equity 合作管理这些资产并拓展该平台。

headline.en: Fasanara and Tether launch $400m private credit fund
headline.zh: Fasanara与Tether推出4亿美元私募信贷基金

summary.en: Fasanara Capital and stablecoin issuer Tether have launched the Tether-Fasanara Lending Fund, a $400m private credit fund. The jointly sponsored evergreen vehicle is targeting up to $3bn in third-party institutional capital.
summary.zh: Fasanara Capital与稳定币发行商Tether已推出Tether-Fasanara Lending Fund，一只4亿美元的私募信贷基金。该联合发起的永续型载体目标募集最多30亿美元的第三方机构资金。

headline.en: Hercules Adviser closes two private credit vehicles with $2.3bn
headline.zh: Hercules Adviser 关闭两只私人信贷工具，募资 23 亿美元

summary.en: Hercules Capital's investment adviser, Hercules Adviser, has raised $2.3bn of investable capital after closing two institutional private credit vehicles. One of the vehicles is the Hercules Evergreen.
summary.zh: Hercules Capital 的投资顾问 Hercules Adviser 在关闭两只机构私人信贷工具后，筹集了 23 亿美元可投资资金。其中一只工具是 Hercules Evergreen。

headline.zh: ICG 的欧洲企业基金募集规模达到 120 亿欧元
